events.verdict: Wagner (ORL) and Garza (BOS) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Wagner (ORL) dislodges the ball from Garza (BOS).

Replay review of the foul called on Garza (BOS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Garza initiates contact with Carter Jr.'s (ORL) lower body that dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Wagner (ORL) deflects the ball away from Banton (BOS).
Banton (BOS) wraps his hand around Wagner's (ORL) waist, which affects his shot attempt.
Scheierman (BOS) cleanly blocks Wagner's (ORL) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that shows if Banchero's (ORL) right foot steps out of bounds as he starts his dribble.
Carter Jr. (ORL) places his hand momentarily on Banton's (BOS) side during the screen.
Suggs (ORL) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Scheierman's (BOS) jersey as they navigate the screen.
Wagner (ORL) makes contact with the ball as he defends Scheierman's (BOS) drive.
Suggs (ORL) legally contests Tonje's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) deflects the ball away from Garza (BOS) and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Celtics.
Carter Jr. (ORL) has a hand resting on Garza's (BOS) body, and the contact during Garza's upward shooting motion is marginal.
Wagner (ORL) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Garza (BOS) directly contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wagner's hand after the release.
Scheierman (BOS) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Carter Jr.'s (ORL) hand that is on the ball, as he elevates for the shot attempt.  A jump ball is correctly called.
Carter Jr. (ORL) grabs and holds Scheierman's (BOS) left arm/shoulder, which affects his ability to pursue the jump ball.
Banton (BOS) legally contests Suggs' (ORL) jump shot attempt.

Carter Jr. (ORL) pursues the rebound and contact occurs with Garza's (BOS) head as he secures the rebound.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Suggs (ORL) initiates contact with Tonje's (BOS) arm and the contact affects his SQBR.
Banchero (ORL) commits a take foul on Walsh (BOS).
Tonje (BOS) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Walsh is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly retained by the Magic.
Banton (BOS) legally contests Bane's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
